title: Universe annual coverage cohort record v0.1.0
description: One firm kept by the annual filing-year continuity rule. This record asserts one mechanical fact -- the firm filed an annual report in every required calendar filing year -- and nothing about its business. The high-recall screen's verdict and provenance are carried through unchanged and are neither re-derived nor revised here; no model was called and no tier exists. Membership in this cohort is analysis eligibility, never membership in a software universe.

accession.description: The baseline filing this row was admitted on. A row is (cik, accession), never a CIK alone.

admission_origin.description: CARRIED THROUGH from the candidate cohort, unchanged. This filter did not admit or re-admit anything.

screen_status.description: CARRIED THROUGH from the candidate cohort, unchanged.

admission_provenance.description: CARRIED THROUGH from the candidate cohort, unchanged: the screen response or reviewer decision that admitted this firm.

observed_annual_filing_years.description: Every calendar filing year in which FRAME records an annual filing for this CIK, ascending. Years after the last required one appear here and decide nothing.

coverage_class.description: Which included population this firm belongs to. The two are labelled rather than pooled because they support panels of different length.

required_filing_years.description: The rule this row was decided under, written into the row so a stored record is interpretable without its manifest.

has_optional_2021.description: Whether the optional pre-period year is present. Recorded, never required.
